descriptions.notStarted: There is a rumor that Han the Broker of Magatia has acquired a new piece of information. Sounds exciting…
descriptions.inProgress: Han the Broker says a suspicious wanderer was staying in Magatia until just a few days ago, but then disappeared without a trace. Han the Broker thinks you might be able to find the wanderer if you follow the traces he left and suggests you first go to Ariant to find him.
descriptions.completed: You met Syras at Ariant Station to ask about the suspicious wanderer that Han the Broker has told you about. Syras at the ticket box desk said a strange man bought a ticket to Orbis.
